subject: C28
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/modal.tsx:35-55: closing a stacked dialog restores the lower dialog's first control instead of the actual opener when the opener is not first. The lower dialog's topmost effect focuses its first control, then the cleanup microtask skips restoration because something already has focus. An independent in-memory production-Modal probe opened the inner dialog from the second outer button and reproduced this I8 violation. Acceptance: Escape and dismissal restore the exact non-first opener, with a regression test covering this ordering while preserving the palette-to-tenant-switcher focus handoff.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/v2/v2-shell.tsx:236-239 and apps/desktop/src/v2/toasts.tsx:18-26: the shell makes its rail and main inert/aria-hidden during a modal, but leaves Toasts outside that isolation. A production-V2Shell probe showing a warn toast followed by the palette found the toast's enabled, tabindex=0 Dismiss button without any inert or aria-hidden ancestor. This fails I8's explicit background-sibling isolation. Acceptance: every nonmodal interactive sibling, including toast controls, is inert and hidden from accessibility while a modal is topmost, and becomes usable again after dismissal; cover toast-plus-palette and Reduce Motion persistence.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/tenant-switcher.tsx:90-138: the fixed portal popup has neither a viewport height limit nor vertical scrolling. The core permits 256 tenants (crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:86); even 20 tenants produce over 750 CSS pixels of rows, extending below the minimum window with no popup scroll container. Lower tenants and Add a tenant become visually unreachable, especially at 200% zoom. Acceptance: bound and scroll the popup within the available viewport, and demonstrate keyboard selection of the last tenant and access to Add a tenant with 20 profiles at minimum sizes and 100%/200% zoom.
evidence_gaps: E1 — tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c28.py and docs/planning/evidence/C28/native-acceptance.json: N03 exercises one palette without an existing toast, and N07 exercises only two tenants. The retained native passes do not establish background-overlay exclusion or T09 long-list usability implicated by R2/R3. Retain updated native AX/keyboard evidence for these states, including minimum-size/200% traversal, against the corrected frozen bundle; add the non-first-opener component regression for R1.
